### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is on the website or documentation.

### URL / Page
Which page or section did this occur on? (e.g. `https://catchbug.bikinan.id/docs/installation` or Hero Section)

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Screenshots / Videos
If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain your problem.

### Environment
- OS: [e.g. macOS Sonoma, Ubuntu 24.04, Windows 11]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 134, Brave, Safari, Firefox]
- Device: [e.g. Desktop, iPhone 15 Pro, Pixel 8]
